Title: Contact Page - Page Load and Display
Preconditions:
- Browser is ready
- User has internet connection
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://testifysolutions.net/contact/
2. Wait for page to fully load
3. Verify page title
4. Check for main content sections
Expected Result:
- Page loads within 3 seconds
- Page title contains 'Contact' or 'Contact Us'
- No 404 or 500 errors
- Header and footer are visible
- Main contact form is visible

Title: Contact Form - All Fields Display
Steps:
1. Locate the main contact form
2. Identify all form fields
3. Verify field labels are visible
4. Check for required field indicators
Expected Result:
- Name field visible with label
- Email field visible with label
- Phone field visible (if present)
- Message/Comment textarea visible
- Submit button is visible and enabled
- Required fields marked with asterisk or 'Required' label

Title: Contact Form - Valid Submission
Preconditions:
- Contact page loaded
- Form is empty
Steps:
1. Fill in Name: 'John Doe'
2. Fill in Email: 'john.doe@example.com'
3. Fill in Phone: '+1-555-0123' (if present)
4. Fill in Message: 'Test message for QA purposes'
5. Click Submit button
6. Wait for response
Expected Result:
- Form submits successfully
- Success message displayed: 'Thank you' or 'Message sent'
- Form clears after submission OR redirect to thank you page
- No error messages appear
- Confirmation email sent (verify if possible)

Title: Contact Form - Required Field Validation
Preconditions:
- Contact page loaded
- Form is empty
Steps:
1. Click Submit button without filling any fields
2. Observe validation messages
3. Verify form does not submit
Expected Result:
- Error message appears for each required field
- Messages are clear: 'Name is required', 'Email is required', etc.
- Form does not submit
- Error messages are displayed near respective fields
- Focus moves to first invalid field

Title: Contact Form - Email Format Validation
Steps:
1. Fill in Name: 'John Doe'
2. Fill in Email: 'invalid-email'
3. Fill in Message: 'Test'
4. Click Submit
5. Verify validation error
6. Repeat with variations: '@example.com', 'test@', 'test@.com'
Expected Result:
- Error message: 'Please enter a valid email address'
- Form does not submit
- Email field is highlighted/outlined in red
- User can correct the email and resubmit
- Valid format: test@example.com passes validation

Title: Contact Form - Name Field Validation
Steps:
1. Test with empty name (already covered in TL-032)
2. Test with single character: 'A'
3. Test with numbers: '12345'
4. Test with special chars: '@#$%'
5. Test with very long name: 200+ characters
6. Test with SQL injection: 'DROP TABLE users'
Expected Result:
- Minimum length validation (if any)
- Special characters handling (accept or reject consistently)
- Maximum length enforced (typically 100-255 chars)
- No SQL injection possible
- XSS attempts blocked: '<script>alert(1)</script>'

Title: Contact Form - Phone Number Validation
Preconditions:
- Contact page loaded
- Phone field is present
Steps:
1. Test with valid formats: '+1-555-0123', '555-0123', '(555) 012-3456'
2. Test with invalid: 'abc123', '123'
3. Test with international: '+44 20 1234 5678'
4. Leave blank (if optional)
Expected Result:
- Valid formats accepted
- Invalid formats rejected with clear error
- International numbers accepted (if supported)
- If optional: blank submission allowed
- If required: blank submission blocked

Title: Contact Form - Message Field Validation
Steps:
1. Leave message blank (if required)
2. Enter 1 character
3. Enter maximum allowed characters (find limit)
4. Enter beyond maximum (if limit exists)
5. Test with special characters and emojis
6. Test with very long text: 5000+ characters
Expected Result:
- Minimum length validation (typically 10+ chars)
- Maximum length enforced (typically 500-5000 chars)
- Character counter visible (if implemented)
- Special characters and emojis handled gracefully
- No truncation without warning

Title: Contact Form - Submit Button States
Steps:
1. Verify button initial state (enabled)
2. Fill form and submit
3. Observe button during submission
4. Verify button after successful submission
Expected Result:
- Button enabled initially
- Button disabled during submission (prevents double-submit)
- Button text changes: 'Submit' → 'Submitting...' or shows spinner
- Button re-enables after submission completes
- Button remains clickable after error

Title: Contact Form - Error Handling Network Failure
Preconditions:
- Contact page loaded
- Network throttling or offline mode enabled
Steps:
1. Fill out form completely with valid data
2. Enable offline mode or disconnect internet
3. Click Submit
4. Observe error handling
Expected Result:
- Error message displayed: 'Network error' or 'Please check your connection'
- Form data is NOT lost
- User can retry submission
- No silent failure
- Error message is user-friendly (not technical jargon)

Title: Contact Form - Server Error Handling (500)
Preconditions:
- Contact page loaded
- Mock server to return 500 error
Steps:
1. Fill out form with valid data
2. Submit form (server returns 500)
3. Observe error handling
Expected Result:
- Error message: 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.'
- Form data preserved
- User can retry
- Error logged for debugging (check console)
- Contact email or phone provided as alternative

Title: Contact Form - Duplicate Submission Prevention
Steps:
1. Fill form with valid data
2. Click Submit button rapidly 5 times
3. Verify only one submission goes through
Expected Result:
- Button disables after first click
- Only one request sent to server (check network tab)
- No duplicate emails sent
- Success message shown once

Title: Contact Form - XSS Prevention
Steps: 1. Enter XSS payload in Name: '' 2. Enter XSS in Message: '' 3. Submit form 4. Check if scripts execute
Expected Result:
- Scripts do NOT execute
- Data is sanitized before display
- Success page does not show unsanitized input
- Backend sanitizes before storing
- No alert boxes appear

Title: Contact Form - SQL Injection Prevention
Steps:
1. Enter SQL payload in Name: 'admin'' OR ''1''=''1'
2. Enter in Email: 'test@example.com; DROP TABLE users;--'
3. Submit form
4. Verify form handles safely
Expected Result:
- Form submission succeeds or fails gracefully
- No database errors exposed to user
- Backend uses parameterized queries (assumed)
- No data corruption
- Application remains functional

Title: Contact Form - CSRF Protection
Preconditions:
- Two browser tabs open
- One with contact form loaded
Steps:
1. Load contact form in Tab 1
2. Inspect form HTML for CSRF token
3. Copy form HTML to Tab 2
4. Try to submit from Tab 2
5. Verify rejection
Expected Result:
- Form includes CSRF token (hidden field or header)
- Submission from different origin/tab is rejected
- Error message: 'Invalid request' or 'Session expired'
- Legitimate submissions still work

Title: Contact Form - Field Character Encoding
Steps:
1. Enter non-ASCII characters in Name: 'José García', 'Müller', '中文'
2. Enter accented chars in message: 'Café, naïve'
3. Submit form
4. Verify data is preserved
Expected Result:
- All Unicode characters accepted
- Data stored correctly without corruption
- Confirmation displays correct characters
- Email received shows correct encoding

Title: Contact Form - Autofill Compatibility
Preconditions:
- Browser autofill enabled
- User has saved contact information
Steps:
1. Click in Name field
2. Select autofill suggestion
3. Verify all fields populate correctly
4. Submit form
Expected Result:
- Autofill suggestions appear
- Fields populate with correct data
- Email, Name, Phone all map correctly
- Form can be submitted with autofilled data
- No JavaScript errors

Title: Contact Form - Tab Navigation
Steps:
1. Click in Name field
2. Press Tab key
3. Verify focus moves to Email
4. Continue tabbing through all fields
5. Verify tab order is logical
Expected Result:
- Tab order follows visual layout: Name → Email → Phone → Message → Submit
- Focus is visibly indicated (outline or highlight)
- No focus trap
- Shift+Tab navigates backwards
- Submit button is reachable via keyboard

Title: Contact Form - Screen Reader Compatibility
Preconditions: - Screen reader enabled (NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver)
Steps:
1. Navigate to contact page
2. Tab through form
3. Verify screen reader announces:
   - Field labels
   - Required fields
   - Error messages
   - Success messages
Expected Result:
- All labels are announced
- Required fields identified: 'Name, required field'
- Error messages read aloud
- Instructions are clear
- ARIA labels present where needed

Title: Contact Form - Mobile Responsiveness
Steps:
1. Load contact page on mobile viewport
2. Verify form layout
3. Fill out form on mobile
4. Submit form
Expected Result:
- Form fields stack vertically
- Input fields are sized appropriately (not too small)
- Labels remain visible
- Submit button is easily tappable (min 44x44px)
- No horizontal scrolling
- Virtual keyboard doesn't obscure submit button

Title: Contact Form - Placeholder Text
Steps:
1. Observe placeholder text in each field
2. Click in field and verify placeholder disappears
3. Type text and verify placeholder not visible
4. Clear field and verify placeholder returns
Expected Result:
- Placeholder text is helpful: 'Enter your full name', 'you@example.com'
- Placeholder disappears on focus or input
- Placeholder is not used as label (labels are separate)
- Placeholder text has sufficient color contrast
- Placeholder reappears if field cleared

Title: Booking Widget - Display and Load
Preconditions: - Navigate to contact page with hash: /contact/#booking-app
Steps:
1. Navigate to testifysolutions.net/contact/#booking-app
2. Verify page scrolls to booking section
3. Verify booking widget/calendar loads
4. Check for iframe or embedded tool
Expected Result:
- Page auto-scrolls to booking section
- Booking widget is visible
- Calendar/scheduling interface loads
- No 'Failed to load' errors
- Widget is interactive (can click dates)

Title: Booking Widget - Date Selection
Steps:
1. Open booking calendar
2. Select a date in the future
3. Verify available time slots appear
4. Select a time slot
5. Proceed to next step
Expected Result:
- Calendar displays current and future months
- Past dates are disabled
- Available dates are clickable
- Time slots appear after date selection
- Selected date is highlighted
- Time slots respect business hours

Title: Booking Widget - Form Submission
Preconditions: - Date and time selected in booking widget
Steps:
1. Fill in booking form: Name, Email, Phone
2. Add any notes/reason for meeting
3. Click 'Schedule' or 'Book Appointment'
4. Verify confirmation
Expected Result:
- Form submits successfully
- Confirmation message: 'Your appointment is scheduled'
- Confirmation email sent to user
- Calendar invite received (if supported)
- User can add to their calendar (Google, Outlook, etc.)

Title: Booking Widget - Timezone Handling
Steps:
1. Check if timezone is detected or selectable
2. Select different timezone (if option exists)
3. Verify time slots adjust accordingly
4. Book appointment
Expected Result:
- User's timezone auto-detected OR
- Timezone selector visible
- Time slots display in correct timezone
- Confirmation shows timezone: '10:00 AM PST'
- No confusion about meeting time

Title: Booking Widget - Conflict Prevention
Steps:
1. User A selects time slot 10:00 AM
2. User B tries to select same slot
3. User A completes booking
4. Verify User B's view updates
Expected Result:
- Booked slots become unavailable in real-time
- User B sees updated availability
- No double-booking possible
- Clear message if slot becomes unavailable

Title: Booking Widget - Cancellation/Rescheduling
Steps:
1. Locate cancellation/reschedule link (in confirmation email or on site)
2. Click link
3. Select new date/time or cancel
4. Verify changes
Expected Result:
- Cancellation link works
- User can reschedule easily
- Cancellation confirmation sent
- Slot becomes available again after cancellation

Title: Newsletter Signup - Display
Steps:
1. Scroll through contact page
2. Locate newsletter signup form
3. Verify elements are visible
Expected Result:
- Newsletter section visible
- Email input field present
- Subscribe button present
- Privacy policy link visible (if required by law)
- Clear description of what user will receive

Title: Newsletter Signup - Valid Subscription
Steps:
1. Enter valid email: 'subscriber@example.com'
2. Click Subscribe button
3. Wait for response
Expected Result:
- Success message: 'You're subscribed!' or 'Check your email'
- Confirmation email sent
- User added to mailing list
- No duplicate subscriptions (if already subscribed: 'You're already subscribed')

Title: Newsletter Signup - Invalid Email
Steps:
1. Enter invalid email: 'not-an-email'
2. Click Subscribe
3. Verify error
Expected Result:
- Error message: 'Please enter a valid email'
- Form does not submit
- User can correct and resubmit

Title: Newsletter Signup - Already Subscribed
Steps:
1. Enter already-subscribed email
2. Click Subscribe
3. Verify response
Expected Result:
- Message: 'You're already subscribed!' or 'This email is already registered'
- No error (friendly message)
- Option to unsubscribe provided (link)
- No duplicate database entries

Title: Newsletter Signup - GDPR Compliance
Preconditions:
- Newsletter section visible
- User in EU region (or simulate)
Steps:
1. Check for GDPR consent checkbox
2. Verify privacy policy link is present
3. Try to submit without checking consent (if checkbox exists)
4. Verify data processing statement
Expected Result:
- Consent checkbox present for EU users OR
- Clear statement about data processing
- Privacy policy link functional
- Cannot subscribe without consent (if required)
- Unsubscribe option mentioned

Title: Contact Info - Display
Steps:
1. Locate contact information section
2. Verify all contact methods are displayed
3. Check for accuracy
Expected Result:
- Email address displayed: testifysolutionsinc@gmail.com
- Social media links present (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Telegram)
- Physical address (if applicable)
- Phone number (if provided)
- Business hours (if provided)
- All information is up-to-date

Title: Contact Info - Email Link
Steps:
1. Click email address link
2. Verify email client opens
3. Check pre-populated fields
Expected Result:
- Default email client opens
- 'To:' field pre-populated with testifysolutionsinc@gmail.com
- Subject line may be pre-filled (optional)
- User can compose and send email

Title: Contact Page - Load Time Performance
Steps:
1. Open DevTools Performance tab
2. Navigate to contact page
3. Measure page load time
4. Check Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
Expected Result:
- Page loads in under 3 seconds on 4G
- LCP under 2.5 seconds
- No render-blocking resources
- Critical content loads first (form visible quickly)
- Booking widget can lazy-load
